applicabilityBasis.summary: wCLP is marketed as a 1:1 CLP wFIAT token for payments and settlement, and the current product page advertises burn-to-bank redemption. The linked October 2025 family whitepaper denies holder claims and redemption rights, but does not name this later token in its deployment list; it cannot conclusively establish this token's current contractual terms. A binding fixed-value issuer redemption/conversion/repurchase obligation under GENIUS section 2(22) is therefore unresolved; the foreign-currency peg alone is not an exclusion.

genius.notes: wCLP belongs to Ripio's Latin American wFIAT suite. The family whitepaper names only an unspecified Ripio group affiliate; the exact legal issuer and domicile are unverified and are not inherited from a wallet operator, a sibling token, or the reserve-bank country. The linked October 2025 family whitepaper denies holder claims and redemption rights, but does not name this later token in its deployment list; it cannot conclusively establish this token's current contractual terms. Product redemption marketing is not treated as a verified enforceable holder policy. The U.S. limited-services notice dated April 29, 2026 describes Ripio US money-transmitter/MSB services for BTC, ETH, USDC and USDT, not authorization for this token. No token/issuer-specific GENIUS approval, publicly confirmed application or intent, state qualification, or registered foreign exception was found in the bounded sources reviewed. OCC/Federal Reserve issuer rules and Treasury section 3 rules remain proposals; the September 30 SCRC interim rule is procedural, not an issuer approval. As of October 7, 2026 the statutory DASP deadlines are not yet active; Treasury describes the expected January 18, 2027 effective date and July 18, 2028 general offer/sale restriction. No token/issuer-specific enforcement action was located in bounded public searches; this is not exhaustive legal clearance. The July 28, 2026 certification is a limited accounting certification for wCLP, not an audit/review or proof of monthly reporting. The certificate contains internally inconsistent dates and currency labels (03.31 in one procedure and ARS/Argentine pesos despite the wCLP/Chile heading), so it is not treated as reliable proof of the claimed reserve currency.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public record naming wCLP and its verified legal issuer as a PPSI, officially pending applicant, state-qualified issuer or registered foreign issuer was located in these bounded checks. The exact issuing affiliate is not established, which limits negative name matching. Proposal-stage rulemaking, a generic pending bank-charter table and legacy MSB/money-transmitter/trust licenses do not independently establish GENIUS status; no absence claim is based solely on an empty search.
